CORAM:
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNISH BHATNAGAR
ORDER % 22.03.2023 CRL.M.A. 7580/2023 (exemption)
Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application stands disposed of.

BAIL APPLN. 949/2023 & CRL.M.A. 7579/2023 (stay)
1.
This is a petition filed by the petitioner under Section 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 214/2023 under Sections 498A/406/304-B/34 IPC registered at Police Station Bawana.
2. Issue notice.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.
3. It is submitted by the learned senior counsel for the petitioner that petitioner is the mother-in-law of the deceased, and there are no specific allegations against her in the FIR.
It is further submitted that deceased has left one year old child, who is very much attached to the petitioner.
He further submitted that petitioner is an old lady aged around 65 years.

4. At the outset, learned APP has read the FIR to counter the allegations made by learned senior counsel for the petitioner that there are no specific allegations against the mother-in-law/petitioner.
A perusal of the FIR shows that there are specific allegations against the petitioner which are serious in nature.
He seeks time to file the status report.
5. Let status report be filed before the next date of hearing.
